errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in alphabetischer Reihenfolge der Regionen angeordnet
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted alphabetically by region. The order on the x-axis is NI, MV, HH, SH, HB. Alphabetical order would be different (e.g., HB, HH, MV, NI, SH).

errors.text_span: und zeigen eine zunehmende Höhe von links nach rechts
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars show an increasing height from left to right, but this is incorrect. The bar for MV (110.22) is taller than the following bar for HH (40.62), which breaks the increasing trend.
